meta.title: The Common Grounds Media Matrix
meta.description: A slide-based journey through what connects Tunisia and Bahrain: seafaring history, culinary crossovers, language, family, faith, dress, crafts, architecture, music, celebrations and people.

intro.title: The Common Grounds Media Matrix
intro.text: A smooth, slide-based presentation comparing the two countries. It charts shared seafaring history, culinary crossovers and language links, and also covers family, faith, dress, crafts, architecture, music, celebrations and people.

ui.hint: Swipe, scroll or use the arrow keys

slides.title: Welcome to Common Grounds
slides.text: Two countries, two seas, one heart. Swipe to discover what connects Tunisia and Bahrain.
